staking.pageSubtitle: Lock funds for a fixed term and earn daily interest.
staking.whatIsStakingBody: Staking locks your tokens to help validate and secure the blockchain. In return you earn rewards (shown as APY — annual percentage yield). Your keys stay self-custodial; assets in a lock period can't be moved until the timer ends.

adminCredit.pageSubtitle: Creates or removes local balance for one user. Internal verification and reconciliation only.
adminCredit.warnPor: This credit creates a spendable balance with no proof-of-reserve check.
adminCredit.warnLiability: The amount becomes the company's liability the moment it is created. This screen does not verify that reserves back it.
adminCredit.warnNotWithdrawal: This credit does not authorise an on-chain withdrawal. Sending funds still requires a separate approval and on-chain verification.
adminCredit.scopeBody: Two uses only — seeding an internal end-to-end verification account, and correcting a reconciliation mismatch. Do not use for events, promotions, airdrops, deposits, or bulk payouts.
adminCredit.disabledBody: This surface is off by default. Adjustments run only while it is on, and turning it on or off is itself recorded in the audit log.
adminCredit.disabledWhere: Turn it on in Platform Settings, and turn it off again when you are done.
adminCredit.unconfiguredTitle: Limits are not set, so nothing can be issued
adminCredit.unconfiguredBody: The per-transaction, 24-hour and cumulative limits must all be set before an adjustment can run. Unset does not mean unlimited — it means blocked.
adminCredit.unavailableNoCoin: No coin uses the local ledger. This screen can only adjust locally-authoritative coins.
adminCredit.loadFailed: Could not load this screen's data. A missing figure here means "unknown", not "zero". If a refresh does not fix it, do not run an adjustment.
adminCredit.modeDebitHint: Removes balance. Only the available part can be removed — anything held by a stake or a pending withdrawal cannot.
adminCredit.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero.
adminCredit.reasonT2Restricted: This coin is T2-halted — right now a credit can only use the Reconciliation fix reason.
adminCredit.descriptionPlaceholder: What is this adjustment for? Include the run or incident it belongs to.
adminCredit.targetHint: Held covers stake principal and pending withdrawals. A debit can only take from the available part.
adminCredit.targetError: Could not read this account's balance. The figures above are unknown, not zero.
adminCredit.limitRollingNote: A rolling 24-hour total. There is no reset time — capacity comes back as older entries pass the 24-hour mark.
adminCredit.confirmTypeEmail: Type the target email to confirm
adminCredit.confirmMismatchEmail: This does not match the email above.
adminCredit.confirmMismatchAmount: This does not match the amount above.
adminCredit.confirmPasteBlocked: Pasting is disabled here — type it yourself.
adminCredit.resultLiability: Local ledger liability for this coin is now {total} {coin}.
adminCredit.resultAuditNote: This adjustment is recorded in the audit log.
adminCredit.resultReplay: This request was already processed — nothing was issued twice.

errors.ADMIN_CREDIT_DISABLED: Balance adjustment is off. Turn it on in Platform Settings — the toggle itself is recorded in the audit log.
errors.ADMIN_CREDIT_LIMIT_PER_TX: Over the per-transaction limit of {limit} {coin}. Do not split it into several smaller adjustments — if you genuinely need more, the limit itself has to be reviewed.
errors.ADMIN_CREDIT_LIMIT_PER_DAY: Your own adjustments in the last 24 hours have reached the {limit} {coin} limit. There is no reset time — capacity comes back as older entries pass the 24-hour mark.
errors.ADMIN_CREDIT_CUMULATIVE_CAP: Cumulative net adjustments for {coin} have reached the {limit} limit. Recovering balance with a debit frees capacity; raising the limit is a separate decision.
errors.ADMIN_CREDIT_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The confirmation entries do not match the form. Re-read the target email and the amount, and type them yourself.
errors.ADMIN_ADJUSTMENT_DEBIT_EXCEEDS_AVAILABLE: More than this account can give up. Of {balance} {coin}, {held} is held by a stake or a pending withdrawal, so only {available} can be removed now. Wait for maturity or release, or clear the position first, then try again.
errors.ADMIN_CREDIT_USER_NOT_FOUND: No user with that email. Check the spelling — this screen does not create accounts.
errors.ADMIN_CREDIT_COIN_NOT_LOCAL: This coin is not locally authoritative. Only coins whose balance authority is LOCAL can be adjusted here. Check the authority-watch panel on the Reserve dashboard, or run the authority transition procedure if this coin should be LOCAL.
errors.UNKNOWN: The server returned a code this screen does not recognise ({code}). The outcome is unknown — check the ledger before deciding what to do. Retrying from the same confirmation screen will not issue twice.
errors.ADMIN_CREDIT_T2_REASON_RESTRICTED: {coin} is halted (T2 — authority violation). While it is halted, a credit may only use the Reconciliation fix reason. Switch the reason type to Reconciliation fix, or use a debit instead — debits have no reason restriction while halted.

autoRenewWarning.inlineTitle: Lowering the rate will refuse {count, plural, one {# pending auto-renewal} other {# pending auto-renewals}}.
autoRenewWarning.inlineBody: {count, plural, one {# active position} other {# active positions}} on {productName} {count, plural, one {has} other {have}} auto-renew on. Each one is checked against this product's rate at the moment it matures. If the saved rate is lower than the rate on the position, that renewal is refused and the principal is released to the user's wallet instead of being staked again.
autoRenewWarning.inlineRestore: Raising the rate back before a position matures restores that position's renewal — only the value at the moment of maturity is used.
autoRenewWarning.inlineSnapshot: Positions already staked keep the rate they were staked at. This change does not alter what any existing position earns.

queryFailed.body: The on-chain or ledger query failed. This is an outage, not a verdict.

stale.title: Verdict is out of date
stale.body: The last run is older than {minutes} minutes. Treat this verdict as unverified.

incomplete.title: Cannot verify yet
incomplete.body: One or more liability components cannot be computed yet. This is not a pass and not a failure — the check has no answer.

unconfigured.title: Reserve side not configured
unconfigured.body: No controlled address is registered, so the reserve side is zero. The arithmetic passes only because both sides are zero — this proves nothing.

unavailable.title: Reserve status unavailable
unavailable.body: Do not read this blank as "verified" or as "zero liability".

liability.title: Claims composition

total.label: Total claims
total.note: This entire amount is what the company wallet must hold.

liability.subset: Components (already inside another line — not added)

settled.label: Sent on-chain (liability discharged)
settled.note: This is the only figure on this panel that represents liability that no longer exists.

claimRail.note: Claiming moves interest into a local balance. It does not reduce the platform’s liability.

held.stakeLockNote: Soft lock — not deducted from the balance.

blocker.t1: Authority listing warning (T1) — new issuance blocked

hint.authorityT2: Resolve via the authority transition procedure.
hint.authorityT1: See the coin authority watch panel below.
hint.por: See the reserve verification panel above.

authority.title: Coin authority watch

stage.unverified: Unverified — watch is off or stale

authority.hubListedYes: This coin is now listed on the hub’s markets response.

t1.impact: New issuance without admin approval is blocked. User-facing functions are unaffected.

t2.impact: Issuance, new positions and withdrawal execution are halted. Read access stays available.
t2.evidence: Observed a non-zero hub balance of {amount} for user {userId} at {when}.

authority.noClear: This alert cannot be dismissed from this screen. It clears when probes return clean, or through the authority transition procedure.

registry.title: Controlled addresses
registry.empty: No controlled address is registered, so reserve verification cannot hold (company wallet unanswered).
registry.addWarning: This change takes effect on the reserve side from the next verification run.

incident.POR_FAIL: Reserve breach — issued claims exceed controlled on-chain holdings for {coin} (run {runId}). Every balance figure on this page is still correct, but the platform cannot honour all of them. Halt issuance and do not approve withdrawals until reserves are restored or claims are reduced.
incident.AUTHORITY_T2: Authority violation (T2) on {coin} — the hub returned a non-zero end-user balance for a locally-authoritative coin. The single property that makes the split-authority model safe is broken. Issuance, new positions and withdrawal execution are halted; do not re-enable them manually. Resolve via the authority transition procedure.
incident.AUTHORITY_T1: Listing detected (T1) on {coin} — the hub now lists this locally-authoritative coin. No user balance has been observed on the hub side, so this is a warning, not a violation. New issuance without admin approval is blocked and probe frequency has been raised.
incident.HOLD_INVARIANT_BROKEN: Hold invariant broken on {coin} — holds total {holds} but open withdrawal requests total {requests}. Either a user can withdraw funds already committed elsewhere, or funds are locked with no request behind them.
incident.HUB_COIN_HAS_LOCAL_BALANCE: {coin} is declared hub-authoritative but local ledger rows exist for it. One of the two is wrong, and either way some balance is invisible on one side.
incident.ISSUING_WITHOUT_VERIFICATION: Issuing without verification — issuance is enabled for {coin} while reserve verification is "{state}". The reserve invariant is the only defence against over-issuance, and it is not currently holding.
incident.UNKNOWN_CODE: Unknown incident code {code} — this admin build may be older than the server. Do not assume it is harmless.
